newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metroplex starts Philippine hotel project.
newsitem.headline: Metroplex starts Philippine hotel project.

text.p: The Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) said Malaysia's Metroplex Berhad has held the ground-breaking ceremony for its third hotel project at the Subic Bay Freeport area north of Manila.
The hotel project, costing 1.3 billion pesos, will have 500 rooms on a 10,000 square metre plot. It is expected to be finished in June next year, the SBMA said in a statement on Thursday.

The value of Metroplex's investments in Subic already totals 1.2 billion pesos. Among its most recent projects were the expansion and renovation of the 82-room Legenda Hotel Casino into a 257-room resort and casino, the SBMA said.
Subic Bay is a former U.S. military base.
